english: no one can take your education from you
also: an educated person always has wealth within himself

terms.latin: Homō doctus in sē semper dīvitiās habet.
terms.comment: Literally “a learned man always has his riches within himself”. Traupman’s word order is in sē dīvitiās semper habet.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
